Welcome, Pioneer. FICSIT has prepared your deployment site.

In front of you stands the Defense Core. It drills deep into this planet - and that is exactly what attracts the local fauna.

The creatures arrive in waves with a single objective: the core. If it falls, the mission has failed. FICSIT forgives a lot. Not that.

Build turrets along their paths. Your factory supplies the ammunition - a turret without ammunition is decoration.

For every wave you repel, you earn FICSIT Coupons. Trade them at the core for build quotas, turrets and repairs.

You will also collect FICSIT Combat Data. Use it in the MAM to unlock new turrets, ammunition and turret levels.

The first wave only begins when you are ready: start it at the core. Use the time. FICSIT values preparation.
